verdict_statement: SUPPORTED.  The derivation survives every attack this runner could mount.  The 929 ladder reproduces on disjoint machinery at 8.3e-14; the derived law G_d(m) = s(m)+s(1)-s(m+1) reproduces the pinned rungs at 8.3e-14; 1000 random states satisfying the theorem's hypotheses H1 and H4 and NOTHING else all obey the identity to 2.0e-15 while the H4-dropped control violates it by 0.763 bit; the identity holds on 500 cells including 476 off the 929 grid, at degrees 3..12, fields 0.02..5.0 and Jt 0.05..5.0, with zero violations; a 50-digit recomputation puts the residual at 7.6e-49, so the float64 result is not a coincidence; the seal recomputes from the pinned bytes under a DIFFERENT inversion and is tamper-evident.  The SSA-equality reading is refuted independently (I(A:R|B) >= 0.004484 bit).  The perturbative candidate is refuted independently (residual 6.1e-16 at statistic values up to 1.286 bit).
